section_summary: This section documents Allied occupation policy and diplomatic negotiations regarding access to Japanese scientific and technical information, including the extension of technical investigations to non-FEC belligerent nations and successive deadlines extending through December 31, 1949. A prominent issue is SCAP's denial of Australian requests to investigate the Japanese acetic anhydride industry due to its reliance on the German Wacker process and Civil Property Custodian restrictions on vested German external assets. The file also includes Norwegian inquiries regarding Japanese industrial technical data, a misfiled despatch on Norwegian English school curricula, and a briefing by Dr. Harry Kelly on the status and post-war restrictions facing Japanese scientists.
